The *Uposathādipucchāvissajjanā* ("Aspects of the legal procedures", Pvr 8) is the eighth section of the *Parivāra* in the Pali Vinaya Piṭaka. The text provides formal definitions of the constituent elements of Saṅgha legal procedures, defining specifically the beginning, middle, and end of such acts. It has been translated into English by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

Computational analysis by DharmaNexus reveals extensive Pali-internal text reuse, recording 170 matching passages across seven Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Significant reuse is also documented with procedural and disciplinary treatises within the Vinaya Piṭaka itself, notably the *Campeyyakkhandhaka* (Kd 9, 27 matches), the *Kammakkhandhaka* (Kd 11, 16 matches), and other *Parivāra* chapters including the *Codanākaṇḍa* (Pvr 13, 14 matches) and the *Kaṭhinabheda* (Pvr 16, 7 matches) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, shared material is detected in commentary and sub-commentary literature, such as the *Pārājikakaṇḍa-aṭṭhakathā* (21 matches) and the *Vinayapiṭake Vinayasaṅgaha-aṭṭhakathā* (10 matches) [DharmaNexus].
